Tobias, the ticket is **#88412**. I've answered you in the thread.

You raised it yourself in #central-team on 2 July 2025: the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging froze when scanning BOL barcodes. Their night shift lead said it hung whenever a Quarendon Freightways driver arrived with a split manifest.

That same thread shows the account was first called "Tansley Packaging", then corrected to Tansleigh Packaging. This is not Tansley Parcel, the account this incident channel covers. No later message in the channel says how the ticket was resolved, so check its status before the customer call.

The answer comes from #central-team, which you're in. A ticket number is fine to share here because everyone in this channel is on the Central team.
